NOTE 05 05.02.2026 GRKP, J  Heard Sri M.Karibasaiah, Ld. Counsel  appearing for the Petitioners/D.HRs.
 C.R.P.M.P.No.4993 of 2015  2.

The Petitioners are the Claimants,
 where the Petitioner No.1 has lost her husband in  a Motor Vehicle accident.

It transpires from the  record that the Petitioner No.1 herein has filed  O.P.No. 330 of 1996 on the file of District Court,
 Anantapuramu seeking compensation of  Rs.20,00,000/- towards death of her husband.
After conducting the trial, the trail Court awarded  compensation of Rs.7,58,000/-.

This Award was  challenged by the Petitioner No.1 in C.M.A.No.
 164 of 2006 before the Hon'ble High Court for  enhancement of the claim.
This Hon'ble Court  passed an Order on 08.11.2011 by enhancing and  awarding compensation of Rs.12,91,945/- as  against the earlier award of Rs.7,58,000/-.
The  sole Respondent has paid part of the amount, but as per the calculation, the Respondent/Judgment SL.
DATE ORDER OFFICE NO.
NOTE Debtor was required to pay balance amount of Rs.6,41,290/-.
For recovery of the said amount, the Petitioner No.1 has filed E.P.No.63 of 2011.
3. It is submitted that in the Execution Petition, both the parties have filed their Calculation Memos before the trial Court.
The Calculation Memo filed by the Petitioner No.1 herein is at Page No.14 of the present C.R.P.

After considering the same, Ld. District Judge has disposed of the E.P.No.63 of 2011 in M.V. O.P.No.330 of 1996 vide Order dated 23.02.2015 stating that the Judgment Debtor is liable to pay Rs.131/- only.
The Claimant in the M.V.O.P has filed the present Civil Revision Petition along with this Application for condonation of the delay of 89 days.

4. Accordingly, delay of 89 days in fling the present C.R.P is condoned.
